content.short: Rumor Perps is a synthetic perpetual futures exchange on BNB Chain with up to 1000× leverage on BTC, ETH and BNB.
content.description: Rumor Perps is a perpetual futures exchange on BNB Chain with no order book: traders go long or short on BTC, ETH and BNB at the Pyth oracle price, and every trade settles against the protocol's liquidity pool. Margin is USDT straight from the wallet, from $1, with up to 1000× leverage. There is no opening fee, no funding and no spread, and a losing trader pays nothing beyond the loss.
